text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well now.
It seems there are more daifuku here than I ordered..."

text_block_list.name: Sweet Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it!
It's on the house from me!

text_block_list.name: Sweet Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
...Acute-chan looks
kind of worn out, after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Well, thank you for that.
I'll be sure to enjoy it~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm, do I really look that tired...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Wonder Acute is still feeling tired from her race.
It might be best to review her schedule.
